chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd al-Wahhāb, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about touching the bone of the dead person, and he said: If a year has passed, then there is no harm in it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on touching the bone of a dead person after a year has passed?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding touching the bone of a dead person. It indicates that once a year has passed, there is no problem in doing so, reflecting jurisprudential discussion on ritual purity and contact with the dead.
